- DOC-010 part 1: "The SSO sign-in option only appears for an email domain the workspace has configured for SSO, and only once the identity provider sync has actually created that person's account."
- DOC-010 part 3: "An admin can check whether the account exists from Settings → People, where an SSO-provisioned account is marked with the identity provider it came from; its absence means the sync has not created it yet."

If you don't see it, likely the sync hasn't created your account yet. An admin can verify in Settings → People. Also note that SSO may be enabled but password sign-in still works.
